description: Recorded evidence of the three-way build-tree hash reproducibility test for the Stage 11C2 modular build (dist-vite/), distinct from the frozen Stage 11C1 bridge tree hash (dist-vite-bridge/, c0407262...).

method.reproduction_a: npm run build:modular then npm run hash:modular
method.reproduction_b: rm -rf dist-vite dist-vite.tree-hash.json, then npm run build:modular, then npm run hash:modular
method.npm_ci_reproduction: rm -rf node_modules dist-vite dist-vite.tree-hash.json dist-vite-bridge dist-vite-bridge.tree-hash.json, then npm ci, then npm run build:modular, then npm run hash:modular; separately rebuilt dist-vite-bridge and reconfirmed its hash unchanged
